title: Operations Analyst – Fulfilment (m/f/d)
description:
Analyse and improve our fulfilment network performance.

What you'll do
- Build reports on pick rates, delivery times and returns with SQL and Power BI

- Propose and track process changes

What you bring
- 2+ years as an operations or process analyst
- SQL, Excel, a BI tool
- Fluent business English; the team is international
